history.name: Orchestrator

mistake_reason: After WebSurfer repeatedly confirmed that English Wikipedia's end-2012 upper estimate was 50 million, Orchestrator forced unnecessary reiteration of the verification steps and then overrode the settled value by adopting a higher, non-Wikipedia 60 million denominator (Step Repetition FM-1.3). This circular, repeated re-checking and disregard of the already validated result caused the final calculation to be made with an incorrect denominator, producing the wrong percentage.
